rows.quote: For replication analyses, we used COPD GWAS summary statistics from the Million Veteran Program (MVP), which included 103,054 European ancestry cases and 315,450 ancestry-matched controls [26].
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the MVP COPD GWAS (ref 26, Verma 2024, with case and control counts) as the dataset used; the dictionary has no Million Veteran Program GWAS row.

rows.quote: Plasma proteome GWAS (pQTL) data were sourced from Sun et al. [37].
rows.coder_note: Ref 37 is Sun J et al. 2023 Genome Med (doi 10.1186/s13073-023-01229-9), a harmonized compilation of seven pQTL GWAS on SOMAscan, Olink and xMAP; that DOI belongs to no dictionary row, and it is neither Sun 2018 (INTERVAL) nor Sun 2023 (UKB-PPP).

The one describing sentence gives 4,907 proteins in 35,559 Icelanders, the exact release N of Ferkingstad 2021, but cites ref 23, Eldjarn 2023 (doi 10.1038/s41586-023-06563-x), whose deCODE row has N 35,892; N and citation identify different rows (rule H conflict).
